description: This TypeScript source file provides utility functions for voice mapping and XML escaping in a voice call provider context. It includes functions to escape XML characters, map voice names from OpenAI to Twilio Polly, check if a voice is openai, and retrieve supported openai voice names. It also defines a constant map for voice mappings and a default Polly voice.

methods.description: Escapes XML special characters in a given string for use in XML responses such as TwiML.

methods.name: export function mapVoiceToPolly(voice: string | undefined): string { mapVoiceToPolly
methods.description: Maps OpenAI voice names to their corresponding Twilio Polly voice names, or returns the input if it's already a Polly or Google voice.

methods.description: Checks if a given voice name is one of the known OpenAI voice names.

methods.description: Returns a list of all supported OpenAI voice names.
